entries.test: Archived web content and contemporary studies could establish whether low-quality service journalism and ecommerce marketing were already widespread online by June 2023.
entries.note: He says he personally is not worried; the proposition generalizes that reaction. It also changes “and/or” to “and.”
“Might” makes the AI forecast a possibility. The accompanying observation about existing SEO content is independently checkable.

entries.note: The surrounding discussion supplies the connection to AI. Despite its colorful wording, the sentence asserts an existing historical condition.

entries.test: Public deployment records and advertising or product metrics could show whether large corporations used AI to increase monetization of internet users and interruptions to their activity.
entries.note: “Will undoubtedly” expresses a firm forecast with no deadline.
